text: Bianchi (F.I.V. Edoardo Bianchi SpA) is part of Cycleurope AB Group, a Swedish company of Grimaldi Industri AB. BikeBiz (2000) called Cycleurope a wholly owned subsidiary of the Grimaldi Industri group and Salvatore Grimaldi the owner of Grimaldi Industri AB.
short: Bianchi is part of Cycleurope AB, of Sweden's Grimaldi Industri AB

source.name: Cycleurope — Our brands: Bianchi
source.quote: Founded in 1885 by Edoardo Bianchi, F.I.V. Edoardo Bianchi Spa is part of Cycleurope AB Group - Swedish company of the Grimaldi Industri AB

additionalSources.name: BikeBiz: Goetzmann ousted from Cycleurope
additionalSources.quote: Salvatore Grimaldi, chairman of the Cycleurope AB board and owner of Grimaldi Industri AB
additionalSources.note: Same article: 'The Cycleurope Group is a wholly-owned subsidiary within the Grimaldi Industri Group.'
